name: OWWA Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own lightweight championship, reassigned at a single pay-per-view battle royal after its first champion fell short of the final four.

name: OWWA United States Championship
epitaph: Awarded to the runner-up of a Heavyweight title decider under the promotion's own Battle of the Best stipulation.

name: OWWA Heavyweight Championship of the World
epitaph: The promotion's own top championship, first awarded in a match tainted by its own management faction's interference.

name: OWWA Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Awarded to the last man standing from the promotion's own four-way Battle of the Best stipulation after the other three titles were claimed.
